title: Family Relaxing in Yard, 1950s B&W Snapshot, Slaughters KY
back_text_transcription:
Dorothy Oakley, Gene Flowers & mother Annie Flowers out in the yard at Aunt Ivy Alters Slaughters Ky.

KIRKMAN CO. CAMERA SHOP JUL 31 1954 211 ENLOW AVE. EVANSVILLE INDIANA VELOCHROME PRINT
description: A relaxed summer snapshot taken in July 1954 showing Dorothy Oakley, Gene Flowers, and his mother Annie Flowers lounging on wooden lawn chairs in the backyard of Aunt Ivy's home in Slaughters, Kentucky. The background features a stone facade house and lush greenery, reflecting everyday mid-century rural American family life.
